heading: Dental emergencies in McLean and Alexandria: questions.
items: Can I be seen the same day?
Wherever possible, yes: space is made in the schedule the same day.
Which number should I call in an emergency?
In McLean, (703) 448-3312. In Alexandria, (571) 617-7245 for new patients and (703) 940-5410 if you are already a patient.
When should I go to the emergency room instead?
If you have neck or head pain, are bleeding uncontrollably, feel dizzy or have suffered severe trauma: call 911 or go to the nearest medical facility.
What should I do with a knocked-out tooth?
Act now: put it back in its socket and hold it there, or keep it in a small container of milk. Do not scrub it clean.
Is sedation available for emergency treatment?
Yes, nitrous oxide or oral sedation, set to you: people arriving in pain are rarely calm.
